info.title: pr-agentic-service batch gateway
info.description: pr-batch /api/v1/<path> through pr-agentic-service as /api/v1/batch/<path>, plus this service's own batch routes (scripts/from-notebook, batch-reports). Any other /api/v1/batch path is 404. See docs/gateway/batch-gateway.md.

400.description: INVALID_IDENTITY: X-User-Id missing or malformed, X-Project-Id/X-Session-Id malformed, user_id query malformed

401.description: LOGIN_REQUIRED (no X-Api-Key) or INVALID_API_KEY (unknown or revoked key)

403.description: FORBIDDEN: unknown or inactive user, or a standard key naming another user in user_id

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the route is not open to key callers, the resource is not visible to the caller, or (our tenant) not a member of X-Project-Id

504.description: Relayed service did not answer in time

parameters.name: X-User-Id
parameters.description: Who calls (always required, every key kind). Our tenant: one of our active users (users.id or employee id). Another tenant: an SSO employee id (system accounts svc-...). Standard key: reads cover only this user's rows. Master key: reads cover the whole tenant. Writes are made for this user.

parameters.name: user_id

schema.description: Only this user's resources. With X-User-Id it must be the same user (403 otherwise).

ActivityData.title: ActivityData
ActivityData.description: Slow work in progress (agent.activity); extra detail may follow.

ArtifactAttachment.title: ArtifactAttachment
ArtifactAttachment.description: Also the data of an ``artifact`` event.

execution.title: Execution
execution.description: 작업을 만든 executor 실행의 trigger, context, metadata

items.title: Items
items.description: 채팅 run 이벤트와 같은 모양 (run_id = report id)

CatchUpMisfire.title: CatchUpMisfire
CatchUpMisfire.description: Run up to max_runs missed occurrences younger than max_age_seconds.

operation_id.title: Operation Id
operation_id.description: 기다리는 작업. null이면 실행 종료(노트북 확정)를 기다림

ExecutorWait.title: ExecutorWait
ExecutorWait.description: Not a question: the run waits for the executor (resumed by events).

InputSlot.title: InputSlot
InputSlot.description: A value the user provides (``source: input``).

LatestMisfire.title: LatestMisfire
LatestMisfire.description: Run only the most recent missed occurrence.

ManualRun.title: ManualRun
ManualRun.description: Run the selected immutable configuration without overrides.

MemoryUpdatedData.title: MemoryUpdatedData
MemoryUpdatedData.description: A project memory topic changed (agent tool or memory worker).

ParallelOverlap.title: ParallelOverlap
ParallelOverlap.description: Run up to max_concurrent at once; extra runs wait (max_queued).

ParamRef.title: ParamRef
ParamRef.description: Where a ``tool_output`` parameter takes its value from.

allow_reject_templates.title: Allow Reject Templates
allow_reject_templates.description: 후보가 모두 등록된 워크플로우(source 있음)일 때만 true: action "reject_templates"로 추천을 거절하고 새 계획을 요청할 수 있음

source.title: Source
source.description: literal: Agent가 정한 값 (overrides로 수정), input: 사용자가 채울 칸 (input_values), tool_output: 앞 호출의 결과, default: tool 기본값 (overrides로 수정)

Policy.title: Policy
Policy.description: Overlap and misfire handling; manual runs also follow overlap.

PolicyPatch.title: PolicyPatch
PolicyPatch.description: Partial policy update; omitted values keep their current value.

QuestionField.title: QuestionField
QuestionField.description: A structured input the agent asks for (written by the model).

QueueOverlap.title: QueueOverlap
QueueOverlap.description: Wait in order; beyond max_queued the run is SKIPPED (capacity).

ReplaceOverlap.title: ReplaceOverlap
ReplaceOverlap.description: Cancel running/waiting runs; start the new one once they stop.

ResultRefs.title: ResultRefs
ResultRefs.description: Executor artifact IDs; download via Executor after ownership check.

RuntimeSpec.title: RuntimeSpec
RuntimeSpec.description: Same shape as the Executor's execution `runtime` object.

Schedule.title: Schedule
